review: Independent source and rendered-interface review accepted the final fix for compact-screen target occlusion. No remaining substantive finding.
limitations: Headless Chromium with software WebGL; physical-device 60 fps and Safari/Firefox have not been verified.
Audio initialization, lifecycle and remembered mute were checked, but sound was not auditioned through speakers.
Arcade checks use stubs; the live portfolio injection, hosted stylesheet and deployment were not exercised.
